waypoints.name: Keechelus Ridge parking area (off FR 4934)
waypoints.note: Same shared approach as all East Face routes: I-90 Exit 54, FR 4832, FR 4934, ~25-30 min hike to the wall.
waypoints.directions: From Seattle, drive east on I-90 to Snoqualmie Pass and take Exit 54, crossing to the north side of the freeway. Turn onto FR 4832 and follow it onto FR 4934 to the small trailhead pullout. A Northwest Forest Pass is generally expected for parking at national forest trailheads in this corridor.

waypoints.name: East Face wall top-out, Keechelus Ridge
waypoints.note: Not a mountain summit — single-pitch crag; top-out is directly above the route line.

waypoints.name: Keechelus Ridge parking area (off FR 4934)
waypoints.note: I-90 Exit 54, north on FR 4832 ~4 mi, left on FR 4934, pass Mount Margaret Trailhead, continue ~3 mi to small parking area on right; ~25-30 min uphill hike/scramble to the East Face wall. Shared by all East Face routes including Project Crack.
waypoints.directions: From Seattle, drive east on I-90 to Snoqualmie Pass and take Exit 54, crossing to the north side of the freeway. Turn onto FR 4832 and follow it about 4 miles, then turn left onto FR 4934, pass the Mount Margaret Trailhead and continue roughly 3 more miles to a small parking area on the right. Allow 45 to 60 minutes on the forest roads from I-90. A Northwest Forest Pass is generally expected for parking at national forest trailheads in this corridor.

waypoints.name: East Face wall top-out, Keechelus Ridge
waypoints.note: Not a mountain summit — single-pitch crag; climbers top out directly above the route at the cliff edge, essentially the same location as the crag itself.
